title: planchonella myrsinifolia subsp. howeana
intro: Planchonella myrsinifolia subsp. howeana, commonly known as the 'Kauai Rosewood', is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. The Kauai Rosewood has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, which help to protect cells from damage and prevent the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of the Kauai Rosewood include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
